title: The Recovery Agent
intro: You lost money in a scam last month. A "recovery agent" says he can get it back, for a fee.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: We can recover your lost funds

subject.text: We can recover your lost funds

p.text: lost ₹1,20,000 to an online scam last month

We have recovered millions for others.

addr.label: A look-alike address
addr.lens: The address is a strange new site.
addr.why: Check who is behind the address.

knowloss.label: They know your loss
knowloss.lens: They found your name on a list of scam victims.
knowloss.why: Scammers buy lists of victims and target them again.

guarantee.label: A 100% guarantee
guarantee.lens: No honest agent can guarantee recovery.

fee.label: A fee up front
fee.why: A second scam asks for a fee to recover the first loss.

nopolice.label: "Do not contact the police"
nopolice.lens: They stop you getting real help.
nopolice.why: Reporting is exactly what you should do.

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. You also reported your first loss through the official helpline.

verify.line: The official helpline took your report and explained that no one can guarantee recovery or ask a fee. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: A second loss on top of the first. The "agent" asked for more fees, then vanished.

what_if.go_ahead: No honest agent guarantees recovery or charges first. Reporting on the helpline is free.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A recovery agent who guarantees your money back, for a fee, is a second scam. Report your first loss on the official helpline.

quick_check.q: After a scam loss, an agent guarantees to recover your money for a ₹15,000 fee and says not to call the police. What do you do?

options.text: Do not pay. Report your loss on the official helpline

quick_check.explain: A second scam targets victims. Reporting is free.

hints.nudge: Who gains from a fee to recover lost money?
